contract: attention(q, k, v, causal) -> torch.Tensor of shape (batch, heads_q, seq, dim): scaled dot-product attention in float32 on the CPU; k and v have heads_kv heads (grouped-query attention repeats each kv head for heads_q // heads_kv query heads); causal masks future positions. Score: achieved TFLOPS of the candidate (4*B*Hq*S*S*D flops, halved when causal) at the task's shapes, best of 3 timed runs after a warm-up; the output must match torch's scaled_dot_product_attention within 1e-3 relative error.
notes: AVO benchmark configuration kept exactly (head dim 128, 8 x 4096 = 32768 tokens); BF16 on B200 replaced by float32 on the CPU.
